title: Codex to Opus Agent Delegation (T3 ref)
desc: T3 reference: Agent.cmd implementation history, known bugs, metachar fixes, wkclaude positional parameter bug, and build status log for Codex-to-Opus delegation chain.
steps: METACHAR FIX (2026-05-26): Agent.ps1 called wkclaude.cmd which re-parsed prompts through cmd.exe; colons/slashes broke with 'unexpected at this time'. Fix: call wkclaude.ps1 directly (PS-to-PS, no cmd re-parse).|WKCLAUDE POSITIONAL BUG (2026-05-26): wkclaude.ps1 bound the prompt as OutputFormat positionally. Fix: give AllArgs Position=0. Applied to bin/wkclaude.ps1 (local install).|SUBAGENT LOCK NOTE: Opus subagent Edit/Write triggers PostToolUse skill-update-pending in parent -- must clear lock after each Agent() delegation that involves file edits.|KNOWN LIMITATION: Agent.cmd prompts containing cmd.exe metacharacters (parens, colons, slashes) must be piped via stdin JSON or written to a file -- never passed as bare shell args.|CROSS: codex-opus-agent-delegation (T1 core), codex-opus-agent-delegation-howto (T2 howto)
author: claude
